_source.generated_by: Orbweaver-Mobile contracts/make_v5_vectors.py (architect, CB-321); to be reproduced by Uplift-Foundation/Orbweaver tools/relay-vectors
_source.encoding: hex is lowercase; ct is standard base64 with padding of nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16) as in session-vectors.json; nonce and frame data are base64url without padding; every plaintext is the canonical form (keys in frames-v5.json's order, the shared escaper, bare integers, no whitespace); png_hex is the frame's encoded bytes, which data carries base64url

_rules: Sealed with session-vectors.json's epoch-0 key and ck key, direction 0 = desktop to phone, 1 = phone to desktop, counters from 200. image_hash = SHA-256 of source_hex's bytes. persona ids are 16 lowercase hex chosen by the sender (these vectors derive them from the name; the desktop derives them from its files; only the grammar and stability are pinned). personas rows sorted by id, default and image_hash present only when true/offered. persona_image windows: frames in order, chunked greedily so each canonical window is at most 48000 UTF-8 bytes and adding its next frame would exceed that; every window carries hash, w, h, frames_total and from_frame; a frame's encoded bytes are at most 32768; ms is 0 on a still and 20..10000 otherwise. The request is answered with the windows, or err unknown_image / bad_frame carrying ref = the request envelope's id.

inputs._note: session_key_epoch0 and ck_key are session-vectors.json's. ck_personas = Ck(ck_key, "personas"); each picture's ck_image = Ck(ck_key, "img:" + image_hash).

pictures.name: still
pictures._note: a still: one frame, ms 0. Degenerate on purpose: the source bytes ARE the frame, so image_hash is the frame's own SHA-256.

pictures.name: animated_small
pictures._note: four tiny frames, one window. The source is synthetic (not a real GIF); the desktop's reproduction hashes source_hex, as it reuses v4's signatures.

pictures.name: animated_wide
pictures._note: six incompressible 64x64 frames of about 16.5 KB each: two fit a window, three do not, so the picture is three windows and every window but the last is maximal.

personas._note: four personas: the default with an animated picture, one with a still, one with no picture, one two-word name with the three-window picture. empty is the negative control for the Personas screen: no fixture persona may stand in for it.

roster._note: RelayRoster.RosterJson's own output (not v4-canonical in general; identical for this ASCII content): persona gains id and image_hash after color, omitted as the rules say. The Windows session has no persona and the Codex one has a persona with no picture.

ms_rule._rule: the desktop's OpenClawAvatars rule, then the contract's clamp: a GIF delay of 10 ms or less becomes 100; otherwise the delay, clamped to 20..10000; a still (one frame) sends 0

cache_rule._rule: one request per hash not held; none while in flight or held; none after unknown_image until re-offered; a hash is one fetch however many desktops and sessions name it

steps.event: roster names H1 on two sessions
reconnect; roster names H1 and H2 again
roster names H3, app relaunched with H1 cached on disk

assembly._rule: assemble by from_frame; complete when 0..frames_total-1 are held; a header (w, h, frames_total) differing from the first held discards the hash's windows and refetches once; out-of-order and duplicate windows are fine
